experiment.name: cub200_frozen_clip_vit_b32_negative_gradient_geometry_randomized_batches
experiment.purpose: test U8-vs-hardest-real tangent-gradient robustness to B64 composition

scientific_control.only_variable: partition of identical holdout positions into B64 batches

partition_method.algorithm: Sequential uses torch.arange(count). Shuffled conditions use torch.randperm(count, generator=torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed)); each order is split into 16 non-overlapping contiguous chunks of 64.

candidate_and_gradient_semantics.u8: normalize((1/8) sum of exact positive-excluded raw-cosine top-8 live image embeddings); selection and weights stop-gradient
candidate_and_gradient_semantics.hardest_real: argmax_{j != i} q_i dot v_j with detached index and live selected logit
candidate_and_gradient_semantics.relative_objective: existing clip_relative_denominator_loss with detached CLIP scale
candidate_and_gradient_semantics.tangent_gradients: existing reviewed unit-norm pre-normalization leaves and normalization Jacobian; unchanged from the sequential diagnostic

robustness_criteria.nature: pre-specified qualitative falsification criteria, not significance tests
